recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, centered photograph of a weathered bronze grotesque mask with a protruding tongue, mounted on a dark wrought iron gate. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the metallic sheen and deep shadows of the sculpture's contorted features, with a subtle blue tint in the eyes providing the only cool accent.
coreVisualRelationships: Central bronze subject against a dark, receding background
Warm metallic highlights contrasting with deep black shadows
Symmetrical composition anchored by the vertical line of the protruding tongue
Text placed in the upper corners to balance the heavy central mass

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central placement, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The protruding bronze tongue at the center-bottom of the mask.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the tongue, then radiates outward to the hair and ironwork.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the corners and behind the iron gate to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold and bronze highlights on the raised surfaces of the mask.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale icy blue for the irises of the eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, relying on metallic luster rather than hue.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallic shades

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all elements to maintain classical elegance.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo box in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the original era.
Provides the necessary traditional structure and legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A macro photograph of a bronze grotesque door knocker with a wide-open mouth and protruding tongue. The lighting should be dramatic chiaroscuro, highlighting the metallic texture against a dark, out-of-focus wrought iron gate. The eyes should have a faint blue glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place serif text in the top left and top right corners in white. Add a small square logo frame in the bottom right corner containing minimalist geometric shapes.

verificationChecks: Is the text in a sharp serif font?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tongue is the central vertical anchor.
Check that the text does not overlap the bronze sculpture.
Verify the background is dark enough to provide high contrast.
Confirm the metallic highlights look like polished bronze.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject: Bronze Sculpture] + [Lighting: Chiaroscuro] + [Background: Dark Wrought Iron] + [Typography: Corner-aligned Serif]
